title: Low-Volume Relief Schedule for Early Closures of the Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service
content:
**Relief clause.** A Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service that booked fewer payouts in the 3 months ending on the closing date than one month's included disbursements of its tier earns 20 percent relief on the early closure fee, one that booked fewer than 3 times that allowance earns 10 percent, and any other service earns no volume relief; the window takes in every payout dated fewer than 3 whole months before the closing date, whole months between two dates being the difference in calendar months between them, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's.

| Tier | One month's included disbursements | 3 times the allowance |
|---|---|---|
| Paystride Instant Pay Starter | 0 | 0 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Core | 100 | 300 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Growth | 500 | 1500 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Pro | 2500 | 7500 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Scale | 10000 | 30000 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Enterprise | 50000 | 150000 |

| Payouts booked in the window | Volume relief |
|---|---|
| fewer than one month's allowance | 20 percent |
| at least the allowance, fewer than 3 times it | 10 percent |
| 3 times the allowance or more | none |

## Boundary cases (Growth figures)

- 499 payouts in the window: fewer than 500, 20 percent. 500 payouts: 10 percent.
- 1499 payouts: fewer than 1500, 10 percent. 1500 payouts: none.

## The window (hypothetical dates, closure on the 15th of a month)

A payout dated the 16th of the month three calendar months earlier is fewer than 3 whole months before the closing date and counts; one dated the 15th of that month is 3 whole months before it and does not count.
